video_title: Indiana Pacers Postgame Media Availability (vs. Timberwolves) | October 7, 2026

quotes.speaker: Rick Carlisle
quotes.summary_phrase: Rick Carlisle reflects on Iowa State's win over Purdue
quotes.excerpt: I was at the game at Purdue last year when Iowa State kicked Purdue's ass.
quotes.quote: For the record, I was at the game at Purdue last year when Iowa State kicked Purdue's ass. I was there. I stayed for the whole thing. I am trying to figure out why that would translate to this kind of heckling.
quotes.social_post: Rick Carlisle shares a funny anecdote about being at the Iowa State game at Purdue last year and getting heckled by fans.

quotes.speaker: Rick Carlisle
quotes.summary_phrase: Rick Carlisle evaluates Tyrese Haliburton's return from injury
quotes.excerpt: I thought Tyrese did great. You got to remember, this has been what, 16 months?
quotes.quote: I thought Tyrese did great. You got to remember, this has been what, 16 months? All that considered, it is not the easiest thing coming back to your alma mater in front of a full house. But I thought he did great considering everything.
quotes.social_post: Rick Carlisle was impressed with Tyrese Haliburton in his return to the court after 16 months, saying he thought the star guard did great considering the circumstances.

quotes.speaker: Rick Carlisle
quotes.summary_phrase: Rick Carlisle praises Jarace Walker's impactful performance
quotes.excerpt: Walker had a very impactful game. He was the biggest plus on the team.
quotes.quote: Walker had a very impactful game. He was the biggest plus on the team, I think it was plus 19. And so that was great to see.
quotes.social_post: Rick Carlisle praised Jarace Walker for his impactful performance against the Timberwolves, noting that Walker finished with a plus 19 rating.

quotes.speaker: Rick Carlisle
quotes.summary_phrase: Rick Carlisle on Jarace Walker's fundamental skill development
quotes.excerpt: I like when he does basic things very well. Rebounding the ball with two hands.
quotes.quote: I like when he does basic things very well. Rebounding the ball with two hands, putting two eyes on the guy he is throwing it to. And that is not just him, that is everybody. Being a threat at all times and making decisive drives on the angle toward the basket, which he did late.
quotes.social_post: Rick Carlisle is emphasizing the fundamentals for Jarace Walker, specifically focusing on rebounding with two hands and making decisive drives to the basket.

quotes.speaker: Rick Carlisle
quotes.summary_phrase: Rick Carlisle on Tyrese Haliburton's consistency during recovery
quotes.excerpt: It would be consistency. It is a pretty devastating situation to have it happen the way it did.
quotes.quote: It would be consistency. It is a pretty devastating situation to have it happen the way it did, when it did, in that kind of a moment. But he had surgery within 24 hours with Dr. O'Malley. We were all certain that he would make a full recovery, which he clearly has. He has been very consistent from that moment for the next 16 months.
quotes.social_post: Rick Carlisle says Tyrese Haliburton has been very consistent throughout his 16 month recovery process following his surgery with Dr. O'Malley.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on returning to play after injury
quotes.excerpt: When you miss some time and you come back, your timing and all those things have to get better.
quotes.quote: When you miss some time and you come back, your timing and all those things have to get better. For me, I feel like I am just playing really fast right now. I just got to slow down. I feel like there was a lot of adrenaline, I was hyped to be out there, excited, but I just got to slow down a little bit.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Haliburton says he is playing a bit too fast in his return to the court and needs to slow down after dealing with a lot of adrenaline in his first game back.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on his changed perspective on basketball
quotes.excerpt: My perspective on life, on basketball has changed a lot through this injury.
quotes.quote: My perspective on life, on basketball has changed a lot through this injury. I think that is the biggest thing. It has been easier for me to take a step back and be like, just appreciate the little things right now. So that is what I am doing, just appreciating all the things that come with this, the good and the bad.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Haliburton reflects on his injury recovery, saying his perspective on life and basketball has changed and he is now focused on appreciating the little things.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton reacts to Braden Smith being heckled
quotes.excerpt: I still don't really understand the reason. I am a little dumbfounded.
quotes.quote: I still don't really understand the reason. I am a little dumbfounded. I mean, I get it, but for lack of a better term, we beat the shit out of Purdue last year. So it ain't like he did anything crazy to us last year. So I don't understand, but that is tough to play your first game in like a college road environment.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Haliburton says he was dumbfounded by the heckling directed at Braden Smith during the game, noting that it is tough to play in a college road environment.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on the 2020 NBA Draft class
quotes.excerpt: I think we all kind of feel like they thought our draft class was going to be terrible.
quotes.quote: I think we all kind of feel like they thought our draft class was going to be terrible. I feel like I have played with half of our draft at this point. It is obviously the NBA is a brother, there is only so many of us. I had the opportunity to play with Aaron and Obi and Sticks and James Wiseman. I think it is really cool.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Haliburton reflects on the 2020 NBA Draft class, noting that many people thought it would be terrible but he has enjoyed playing alongside several members of that group.
